review_runs.investigation: Whether the M1 single-verb path is shaped to become the security choke point
review_runs.result: It is not yet load-bearing: protected file I/O precedes checks, the checks omit operation constraints, and the unauthenticated browser surface can reach the path. For M1, a synthetic ingress root and launch authentication are recommended; resource-bound import tickets remain with the later host-side spine.

findings.gate: Before real sensitive data or untrusted content
findings.summary: JEFF can request arbitrary host paths; mint/attach resolve and persist file bytes before authority/grant checks, then desk projection may send imported text to the remote model provider.
Loopback HTTP and SSE endpoints have no launch authentication or origin/host checks, and /verb accepts a caller-supplied actor.
The check stubs receive only actor, verb, and entity, so they cannot bind future policy to facet, source resource, revision, payload, scene, destination, or budget.
Direct core.scene replacement and recursive projection can bypass place semantics and create persistent cycles; shared Store.sync has no lock around last_applied plus tail application.

review_runs.investigation: The minimum non-transferable adoption record and executable identity for safe collaborative updates
review_runs.result: Use four separate identities: a portable definition with logical capability slots, a versioned execution contract, a locally resolved installation plan, and a local standing adoption policy in the keep. Exact runtime builds belong in per-launch execution snapshots; compatible platform security patches should re-run conformance without prompting for every app. A foreign world carries only inert definition and evidence claims. Same-owner forks may inherit policy only through a keep-created local lineage relation, never copied IDs.

findings.gate: Before portable components or shared application branches
findings.summary: The current component digest combines source with concrete local entity bindings and permissions. A shared definition should instead declare logical slots; the recipient resolves them into a local plan so one code revision can be shared without sharing object IDs or authority.

Plan equality or reduction cannot by itself authorize new code. Quiet adoption also needs a user-selected authorship or review rule, a compatible execution contract, fresh non-revoked update metadata, and required local evidence.

findings.gate: Before runtime upgrades or world rollback can affect installed applications
findings.summary: Record the exact engine and validator build in each execution snapshot, but keep user application policy bound to a semantic contract. Same-contract security patches can re-run platform conformance without per-app prompts; incompatible semantics pause on the protected default desk. Revocation and accepted release-sequence or causal-frontier state remain outside world rollback.

review_runs.investigation: Which writes remain safe when collaborators run different application versions against shared data, and how code rollback preserves newer work
review_runs.result: Gate compatibility per immutable semantic operation rather than per application version or parseable schema. A write may commit only when its translation has one bounded meaning, its read and write sets are explicit, the writer could observe everything it can replace, and current invariants and authority pass. Ambiguous or lossy translations remain attributed proposals or make that operation read-only. Code rollback keeps the current data head and uses a pinned adapter or partial capability list; it never implies down-migration, authority rollback, or effect replay.

findings.gate: Before the first mutually untrusted shared writer
findings.summary: The local prototype has an event-format version but FacetRecord and facet-attached carry no facet schema identity. attach records whole replacement bodies and its revision precondition is optional. Additive event parsing therefore does not prevent a current but older-shaped writer from erasing newer fields.

Give shared facets an immutable semantic operation vocabulary. The trusted gate supplies writer schema, operation identity, read set, and derived write set. Stable bounded operations may commit; a write that could touch facts hidden from its writer becomes a proposal or read-only capability.

findings.gate: Before portable schema adapters influence validation or authority
findings.summary: Schema-carried lenses are claims. Pin immutable schema, adapter, and path identities; run adapters with deterministic bounds and no credentials; and surface non-equivalent paths as conflicts. Adding a shorter path must not silently reinterpret an accepted effect.

findings.gate: Before state migration or code rollback
findings.summary: Migrations are explicit idempotent candidates on a named input head and never run during open, render, or replay. Rolling back code keeps the current data head and current revocations; old code receives a safe translated view, partial operations, or read-only inspection instead of an implicit down-migration.
